d=open('/app/a.out','rb').read()
def nz_words(a,b):
    n=0
    for o in range(a,b,4):
        w=d[o:o+4]
        if any(w): n+=1
    return n
print('file 0x2db8-0x3000 nonzero words',nz_words(0x2db8,0x3000),'of',(0x3000-0x2db8)//4)
print('file 0x3000-0x3db8 nonzero words',nz_words(0x3000,0x3db8),'of',(0x3db8-0x3000)//4)
print('file 0x3db8-0x3e58 nonzero words',nz_words(0x3db8,0x3e58),'of',(0x3e58-0x3db8)//4)
# disagreements A vs Cpage over all overlapping addresses
def word(o): return int.from_bytes(d[o:o+4].ljust(4,b'\0'),'little')
# build A and Cpage_unicorn
A={0x400000+i:word(i) for i in range(0,len(d),4)}
Cp={}
P=0x1000
segs=[(0,0,0x628,0x628),(0x1000,0x1000,0x175,0x175),(0x2000,0x2000,0xf4,0xf4),(0x2db8,0x3db8,0x258,0x260)]
for fo,v,fs,ms in segs:
    start=(v//P)*P; end=((v+ms+P-1)//P)*P
    for a in range(start,end,4):
        addr=0x400000+a
        Cp[addr]= word(fo+(a-v)) if v<=a<v+fs else 0
dis=[a for a in set(A)&set(Cp) if A[a]!=Cp[a]]
print('A vs Cpage disagreements',len(dis),'A size',len(A),'coverage if omit:',(len(A)-len(dis))/len(A))
PY
